evidence.detail: Never-enabled serve/browser/CLI: no hub files, fields, output or requests; differential against RFC_BASE_SHA helper identical after normalizing random/time fields.
Exact v1 record keys at host start, CLI and browser publication points; unserved/loopback and private review content absent.
6 s and unreachable fixture hubs and broken hub.json: answers saved, browser under 1.5 s, unchanged exit semantics, non-overlapping coalesced attempts, warning appears and clears.
Invalid origins refused before configuration; impostor certificate and 307 redirect receive/forward no capability; diagnostics carry no payload/token.
Identical heartbeat records at the interval without advancing sequence or revision; constants 300 s and 3 s.
Disjoint counts/states across mixed phases, withdrawal, pause, partial handback and resume; stop/restart and 6 concurrent CLI callers preserve revision ordering.
Flag over environment over saved; reuse across shells and host attachment; --no-hub clears and cancels; no browser network wait; symlinked skill in two consumers.
